h: Lagos police commissioner orders detention of officers seen harassing a young man in Ikorodu
p: The Lagos police commissioner has reportedly ordered the detention of officers captured on video harassing a young man in Ikorodu. The footage spread online and drew public anger, and an internal investigation is said to be under way.
more: The video went viral on social media this week.
Rights groups have called for the officers to face disciplinary action.
